grammar.summary: 本课学习表让步的 if 条件句虚拟（非真实）。

points.title: if + 过去式, would 虚拟条件句
points.explanation: If people were not so competitive, sport would be... 与现在事实相反：从句过去式、主句 would do。初步感知虚拟语气。

examples.en: If the moon were a perfect sphere, ...
examples.cn: 假如月亮是个完美球体……

points.title: 表程度递进的 as much as 比较
points.explanation: Sport is as much a matter of instinct as of training. A as much as B = 与其说B不如说A同等重要。

examples.en: Sporting activities are essentially modified forms of hunting behaviour.
examples.cn: 体育活动本质上是狩猎行为的演变形式。
